summary: Frontend-only testing of Smart Excel Reader app focusing on the new multi-file Home screen architecture. All 8 features from the review request verified successfully. Home screen shows My Files section, Add File button, Quick Actions grid, and empty state. Filter tab shows 'No Data Loaded', Layout tab shows 'No Files Loaded'. Bottom navigation with 5 tabs (Home, Filter, Parchi, Inventory, Layout) working correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Add File button navigates to /files which requires authenticated session. When no session exists, redirects to login page. This is expected behavior but user may be confused.

issues: Filter and Inventory action cards appear grayed out/disabled when no data is loaded - good UX design but could add tooltip explaining why
Dark background (#1a1a2e) contrasts well with white text - good design choice for warehouse view theme

react_native_issues.component: All screens using shadow* style props
react_native_issues.issue: MINOR: Deprecated shadow* style props warnings in console logs - cosmetic, not affecting functionality

critical_code_review_comments: parchi.tsx is 971 lines - consider splitting into smaller components (ParchiHeader, ParchiTable, ParchiFooter, ParchiModals) for better maintainability
store.ts file structure is clean and well-organized with separate registries for files, active excel data, and layout data
All tab components properly handle empty/no-data states with user-friendly messages and navigation to Home
Filter and Inventory quick actions are correctly disabled when no data is loaded (good UX)
